source:
—Crazy love—

A mysterious young man who suddenly appears before your eyes.
He looks like a high school student, but no one knows his true identity.

"Don't be so scared. I won't do anything."

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/sullyland/chara/?page=6]official website[/url]]
